**Prior Degrees:** Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in the mechanics of industrial structure

I'm in the 4th year of engineering school at Polytech Montpellier, studying the mechanics of industrial structures. My objectives are to deepen my knowledge in the field of the welding. Thus, I came to carry out an internship of 2 months within the CCWJ. 

#### Project

I am currently studying to become an engineer in the field of industrial structure mechanics. I am doing this internship in order to improve my skills in different welding processes, especially fiction welding.
